snippet.title: Midnight Watcher: Village - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Get a look at the Official Trailer for Midnight Watcher: Village, a survival horror adventure game developed by RainStyle Games. Players will assume the role of a shift guard in a desolate village in Siberia. Explore the surroundings, manage resources, and survive the night at all costs. Midnight Watcher: Village is coming soon to PC (Steam).

#IGN #Gaming
